routes.localStopPolicy: stop after the first timeout, public-gate failure, private-oracle failure, malformed-input throw, or raw-payload leakage; use advisor-only before hybrid for this tiny schema shape
routes.notes: The hardened live run passed all four arms. The result is positive evidence for local-only screening on a tiny one-file policy-schema validator. It is negative evidence for mandatory hybrid-router review on this task shape because hybrid used 91,279 frontier tokens versus 45,713 for frontier-only. Advisor-only also passed with 15,301 frontier tokens, so advice-plus-local is the cheaper escalation candidate when local-only fails.
